items.title: Deere (DE) Could Be 2% Below Fair Value As Board Change Tests Premium
items.summary: Deere (DE) just expanded its board to eleven directors, bringing in former Ernst & Young U.S. CEO Julie Boland. Her background in finance and governance immediately puts board oversight in focus for investors. Recent trading puts Deere at a share price of $671.65, with a 90 day share price return of 8.19% and a year to date share price gain of 43.88%, while the 1 year total shareholder return sits at 45.22%.
